name: q3-rl-certified-candidates-20260912
scope: Q3 only; CPU-only policy research; no official simulator interaction
policy_expectation: Learn whether a proposed action is worthwhile given observation history and its effect on whole-episode cost; neither recurrent memory nor RL alone proves global optimality.
initial_checkpoint_selection: Best of the three already completed old CPU development endpoints on their original development set; report all three, not a new independent superiority claim
rl_reference: Always evaluate the exact frozen best prior base RL parent separately from the modified method zero-training initialization; pair all endpoints against both it and state search
partition_rules: Training variants share the same per-replication scenario sequence where budget permits. Development may guide decisions. Confirmation requires a frozen model. Do not reuse confirmation to tune and call it independent. Final and stress are opened only after model selection is frozen.
official_database: Entire practice_training.sqlite3 is validation only; no imitation, distribution fitting, normalization fitting, or invented counterfactual feedback
variants_planned: Unchanged base-action PPO continued from the selected endpoint
Additional useful localization probe candidates, policy-selected
Current-position or bounded target-position discovery measurements, policy-selected
Recurrent policy trained on actual observation sequences with correct episode resets
experiment_rules: Implement and audit mechanisms before large runs. Compare zero-additional-training candidate behavior and matched-budget continued base PPO. Retain all training seeds and endpoint outcomes. New mechanisms must be separately versioned and frozen. An added candidate set may change initial probabilities; do not claim lossless migration unless verified.

cost_to_go_extension.rollin_and_continuation: Freeze current v3/base/flat actor for each batch, use greedy roll-in and continuation; one independently sampled public decision prefix per new generated world
cost_to_go_extension.actions: Original greedy, highest frozen-logit legal runner-up, and one uniformly sampled remaining legal action without replacement; retain old uniform mode for explicit ablation
cost_to_go_extension.target: Actual remaining complete virtual cost after the common prefix, including forced action and full safety fallback; penalize unsuccessful or unsafe completion explicitly
cost_to_go_extension.update: Compare each evaluated alternative only with the original greedy action using cost-gap-weighted pairwise logistic loss; omit alternative-versus-alternative pairs. Full-candidate KL to the batch-frozen actor; no critic regression
cost_to_go_extension.inference: Original observation-only candidate actor; no ground-truth access, scenario replay or online lookahead
cost_to_go_extension.budget_units: One group can require a baseline and two full replay trajectories. Report groups, completed/attempted trajectories, simulator actions and wall time separately; do not equate a group with one PPO episode
cost_to_go_extension.comparison: Use identical held-out case hashes and total CPU/wall allowance; the interrupted base-r1 first block is not an exactly matched effective training-time control
cost_to_go_extension.generalization: Fresh disjoint generated training worlds. Fixed development pairing guides selection only; confirmation/final/stress remain sealed until policy identity is frozen
cost_to_go_extension.scope: Finite sampled actions and approximate observation representation under the current continuation policy; no global-optimality guarantee
cost_to_go_extension.revision_hypothesis: Failed all-pairs run spent almost all scalar logit derivative in one audited group ranking two negligible-probability losers. Focus comparisons on the actual deployed greedy decision and a plausible competitor; full closed-loop evaluation remains necessary
cost_to_go_extension.unchanged_limitations: Gap weights still clip at 2 with a 100-second scale and do not exactly optimize expected time; per-world uniform prefix sampling weights each trajectory equally; softmax KL cannot guarantee unchanged or improved greedy choices
cost_to_go_extension.ablation: cost2-r1 tests original-only pairs plus runner-up sampling; costpairs-r1 tests original-only pairs with the old uniform sampling if budget permits. Neither result establishes the isolated effect of both changes without the ablation

cpu.resource_scope: Entire inherited process affinity, including sampling, optimization, evaluation and result synchronization; concurrency settings are not additive permission to exceed the cap

lower_bound.primary: L/5+5N, original physical oracle relaxation; L from exact clearance-disk graph subset DP
lower_bound.aggregation: sum(actual time)/sum(case lower bound), also retain each case ratio
lower_bound.caveat: Not an achievable unknown-scene online optimum; no denominator switching

acceptance.tradeoff_policy: A mean/tail tradeoff remains a conditional candidate; do not call it an unconditional upgrade

artifact_rules: Only versioned project code and anonymous generated results in dedicated storage folder; no credentials, account identifiers or unrelated files. Risky operations need user confirmation. Never delete initial branches or unarchived work.
stop_rules: Continue meaningful evidence-led exploration until the deadline, verified plateau across investigated mechanisms, or account remaining quota <=1%. No reset credits. Explain untested directions and distinguish resource limits from theoretical optimality.
active_experiment: PPO with certified_cover candidate filtering; full-continuation trainer retained but inactive

certificates: MAX_SOURCES distinct known accepted channels exhaust unknown sources
certified_candidates.scope: Remove cover candidate rows only; preserve source actions, ordering, actual measurement ledger and conservative fallback
certified_candidates.does_not_claim: Filtering does not force a clear or choose a route. Candidate pooling changes; unchanged parent weights do not imply unchanged action probabilities or better rollout performance.
certified_candidates.comparison: Separate zero-additional-training behavior from PPO training improvement; always compare against frozen prior RL parent and state reference
certified_candidates.not_implemented: No safe-clear availability pruning; no outer-domain or relative-negative geometry certificates in this first variant
certified_candidates.preserved_autonomy: Keep known-channel cover measurements even when a safe clear action exists. More information may shrink uncertainty and reduce future movement; safe clear availability alone is not a proof of zero value of information.
